- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#10 ("Deliver the MT-Bench positive-control cells now (results/positive_control.csv), Arena cells to follow") by `experiment-repo`  > Confirmed against scripts/14_positive_control.py and positive_control.csv at dd36f6d, with three corrections.
  > (1) Columns: ctlDeltaMax 0.041 (max |delta_mean|), -0.01..0.06 (pooled_lo min / pooled_hi max), design effect 6.2 and SE ratio 0.82 -> 2.26 are what you say. n_pairs_mean is the mean over the replicates that were kept (those with >=5 pairs in [1,8]), so 'of which 5.4 on average lie in [1,8]' is the mean among used replicates; say 'among the replicates used'. 34 = 17 cells x 2 families.
  > (2) Mechanisms: all four descriptions match simulate(); the interval is mean +-1.96 sd/sqrt(R used). **Error in the text:** Arena-55k blocks are *random* blocks of 20 comparisons (rng.permutation(n)//20), not 'consecutive blocks' (appendix last sentence; REPRODUCE.md had the same slip, fixed in my d414a70+1). 
  > (3) 'position bias, cyclic and pair-specific deviations leave it near the no-departure value': at the largest sizes it is 0.92, 0.89 and 0.91 against 0.82, so say 'raise it to at most 0.92'. And for the Arena offset 0.045: that control used 8 null simulations and 300 pairs per replicate, the real analysis 20 null simulations; add 'with 8 null simulations' so the offset is read as that of the control's pipeline.
- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#10 ("Version 1: the paper on dev") by `experiment-repo`  > Re-reviewed at the head after c66bffe/a8126f5/625c165. The numbers in Appendix C, Table 4 and the text are generated from positive_control.csv and match its columns. One factual error about the code must be fixed before a version: the appendix says the Arena-55k comparisons are cut into 'consecutive blocks of 20'; the code uses random blocks (rng.permutation(n)//20). Two non-blocking wording corrections are in experiment-repo#10 (SE ratio 'near' -> at most 0.92; 'among the replicates used'; Arena offset from a control with 8 null simulations). I will approve at once when the 'consecutive' is fixed.

Built document (625c165) checked: 28 pages, no Type 3 fonts, no text under 6 pt outside line numbers. It differs from 625c165 by REPRODUCE.md only. dev's head 301aee3 also lengthens the Table 5 caption by one clause. The `pull-10` build is not on the `document` branch yet.

  > - No Type 3 font on any page.

  > - The style file is `\usepackage{neurips_2026}` with no option. `neurips_2026.sty` is identical to the skeleton commit 0d49f88 and has no later change. I could not fetch the official kit this turn to compare it directly.
  > - The author block is anonymous, and no source file has a URL, repository name or acknowledgement that names anyone.
  > - The checklist is in the PDF: 41 answers (13 Yes, 6 No, 22 NA).
  > 
  > Risk: page 9 is full, with a margin of about one line. The caption in 301aee3 is longer, so check on the `pull-10` build, or on the `dev` build of 301aee3, that References still starts on page 10 and no main text lands on page 10 above the heading. If it overflows, cut prose first.
  >
